factualReview.reviewer: Codex Root, independent Science and Nature reviewer
factualReview.notes: Independently read all250 bilingual records and actual cached supporting passages. Followed up missing predicates with full paragraphs; the root source-read log binds68 targeted paragraph groups. Independently read Purdue corn morphology, Natural History Museum harbour-seal whisker tracking, Smithsonian insect-zoo acacia/ant exhibit, guttation and Schrödinger-cat introductions. Verified crocodile/alligator accepted aliases against Smithsonian animal-care passages. Removed unsupported explanatory details and refined taxonomic scope rather than approving vaguely related citations.

editorialReview.reviewer: Codex Root, independent Science and Nature reviewer
editorialReview.notes: Read all250 questions,50 category titles and every final old/new collision pair against the complete8374-record baseline including Finals. Replaced repeated underlying facts with new queried facts; explicitly separated shared subjects with distinct intended information, such as Curie Nobel disciplines versus mobile X-rays, Pasteur swan-neck contamination experiment versus pasteurization naming, and Lyell/Harvey work scope. Checked exact allocation, five distinct primary subjects, title scope, unique sets and zero final answer-giving aliases.

translationReview.reviewer: Codex Root, independent Science and Nature reviewer
translationReview.notes: Independently read every English/Estonian clue, response, explanation and variant, then all329 grouped translation diagnostics. Corrected animal taxonomic names, number spacing, plant terminology, phrasing and response specificity. Confirmed Hääletu kevad from the Estonian National Library catalogue and kärniguaan terminology in official EU Estonian material. Used plain dance wording where an Estonian technical label was uncertain. Scientific names are paired across languages; reviewed diagnostic exceptions are field-specific.

resolvedFindings: Replaced Mendel pea inheritance with Brown pollen movement; Pasteur heat-treatment naming with the swan-neck broth experiment.
Replaced repeated Nobel/dynamite with1875gelignite; Wegener/continental drift with the1906balloon endurance flight with Kurt Wegener.
Replaced rhubarb toxic-leaves/stalks with Purdue-supported corn tassels and silk-bearing ears; replaced leaf-cuticle waterproofing with root-pressure guttation.
Changed flying-squirrel generic gliding to its wrist-cartilage wingtip support; changed mangrove oxygen roots to seeds germinating on the parent, keeping the separate pneumatophore question distinct.
Clarified pit-viper rather than generic snake heat organs, Phrynosoma horned lizards, crocodilian mothers, male-only emperor-penguin incubation and only some caddisfly larvae.

Removed unsupported Röntgen ring, musk-ox undercoat, meerkat progressive-scaffold, direct leaf-eating and Harvey consumption details; kept the star-nose clue about touch rather than disputed electroreception.
Bound Planck quanta, Becquerel dark plates, Volta stacked-metal battery and Faraday coil/magnet induction to actual supporting source paragraphs.
Corrected seal whisker citation, swollen-thorn acacia common-name scope and Schrödinger hypothetical-cat citation to passages containing the exact claims.
Removed Voltaic-pile and annual-sediment-layer answer aliases from clues that would give those accepted answers; repaired carrot, koala, lungfish, mangrove and climate phrasing.
Corrected honeyguide from meelind to meenäitur, star-nosed mole wording, merikuradilised scope, varve/speleothem Estonian terminology and Vervet species specificity.
Qualified climax-community wording as a classical model, carrying capacity as maximum, and C4 mechanism with reduced photorespiration in hot conditions.
